metaTitle: Baby Shower Dessert Cups by Colour, Hamilton & GTA
metaDescription: Blush-pink, lilac, saffron-orange and pistachio-green dessert cups for your baby shower. Mini Shots for grazing, packs of 24, 48 or 96, made fresh in Hamilton.
h1: Baby shower dessert cups, picked by colour
intro: A lot of showers start with a colour and a theme. Our hand-layered dessert cups and mini dessert shots already come in blush pink, lilac, pale yellow with saffron orange, and pale pistachio green, so choosing baby shower dessert cups mostly comes down to choosing flavours. Your cups are made fresh in Hamilton, Ontario, the morning of pickup or delivery, in packs of 24, 48 or 96.

sections.heading: Start with the shower's colours
sections.body:
Every flavour on our menu has its own look, and four of them sit in the soft range a lot of showers go for:

- **Blush pink: [Strawberry Fields](/menu/strawberry-fields).** Blush-pink strawberry cream under a glossy red compote, finished with cream rosettes and strawberry.
- **Lilac: [Blueberry Haze](/menu/blueberry-haze).** Lilac blueberry cream under a near-black violet compote, topped with fresh blueberries.
- **Pale yellow and saffron orange: [Mango Dream](/menu/mango-dream).** Pale yellow mango-tinted cream cheese under a saffron-orange mango layer, with a cream dollop on top.
- **Pale pistachio green: [Dubai Chocolate](/menu/dubai-chocolate).** Pale green pistachio cream, golden kunafa strands mid-cup, dark ganache and a green marbled swirl. Contains tree nuts.

Strawberry Fields, Blueberry Haze and Mango Dream are Classic. Dubai Chocolate is Premium. Classic and Premium mix freely in the same box.

sections.heading: Pink, blue, or keeping it a surprise
sections.body:
**Pink theme.** Lead with Strawberry Fields. On its own it fills a table with blush and red. Add Mango Dream for a warmer, peachier mix.

**Blue theme.** Blueberry Haze is our closest to blue, and the question below, "Is there a blue dessert cup for a boy baby shower?", covers how to style it.

**Neutral or a surprise.** Mango Dream (pale yellow under saffron orange) and Dubai Chocolate (pale green) give you a yellow-and-green pairing for a gender-neutral shower. For a teddy-bear or oat-and-cream theme, [Biscoff Bliss](/menu/biscoff-bliss) adds caramel-tan cream, an amber top and a cookie standing upright. Tiramisu adds a matte, cocoa-dusted top.

**All of the above.** A 24 holds up to four flavours, with at least six cups of each. Six each of Strawberry Fields, Blueberry Haze, Mango Dream and Dubai Chocolate puts all four shower colours in one box. [Start a 24 for your shower](/order?pack=24&event=baby-shower).

sections.heading: Mini Shots for grazing, Dessert Cups for dessert
sections.body:
If the cups share the table with other food, Mini Shots are the easy choice. At 2 oz they're tasting size, so a guest can take a pink one and a green one without committing to a full dessert. If the cups are the dessert, go for Dessert Cups: 5 oz, a full serving.

A 48 of Mini Shots holds up to eight flavours at six each. A 96 lets you go deeper on each colour: 24 each of four flavours makes bold blocks along a long table.

A 48 of Mini Shots is $88 Classic or $115 Premium, and every pack and size is priced on [the packages page](/packages). Mixed boxes are priced cup by cup at each flavour's tier. For example, a 48 of Mini Shots with 12 each of Strawberry Fields, Blueberry Haze, Mango Dream and Dubai Chocolate comes to about $95 before delivery. The same mix in Dessert Cups comes to about $214 before delivery. [Start a Mini Shots 48 for your shower](/order?pack=48&size=2oz&event=baby-shower).

sections.heading: How many to order (a suggestion)
sections.body:
This is a suggestion, not a rule. It assumes one Dessert Cup per guest when the cups are the dessert, or about two Mini Shots per guest when they share a grazing table with other sweets.

Take a 30-guest shower. If the cups are the dessert, a 48 of Dessert Cups covers everyone with 18 to spare. On a grazing table, 30 guests at about two Mini Shots each comes to about 60. That's more than a 48 holds, so it rounds up to a 96.

Full guide on [packages](/packages).

sections.heading: Timing a weekend shower
sections.body:
If your shower is on a weekend, the day decides how the cups reach you.

- **Saturday shower:** we deliver on Saturdays across the GTA. The fee depends on the location, and we quote it after we confirm your order.
- **Another day:** delivery runs on Saturdays, so ask about pickup in Hamilton in your request.

Prefer pickup? It's free in Hamilton and arranged with you, and we share the location once your order is confirmed.

A countdown for a Saturday shower:

- **Once the colours are set:** choose your flavours and pack.
- **Wednesday:** send your request. We need at least 48 hours' notice. The 48-hour mark is the same time on Thursday as your delivery. We suggest Wednesday to stay clear of the urgent window.
- **The day you send it:** we confirm your request.
- **Saturday morning:** we make your cups fresh, then deliver them.

Under 48 hours' notice counts as urgent. Urgent orders depend on availability, and we can't guarantee them.

sections.heading: Allergens for a mixed crowd
sections.body:
A shower guest list can run from grandparents to little cousins, so check the allergen notice at the foot of the page before you settle the mix.

Of the four shower colours, only the green cup, Dubai Chocolate, is flagged for tree nuts. Leaving it out takes that flavour off your table, but that works for preference, not for an allergy: every cup is made in the same kitchen, so cross-contact is possible. We don't describe any cup as nut-free.

{{dietaryClaim}}

If a guest has a nut allergy or any other severe allergy, message us before you order.

sections.heading: Setting the shower table
sections.body:
Coloured layers do much of the decorating for you. A few ways to use them:

- **Pick a side.** For a "pink or blue?" shower, set Strawberry Fields at one end of the table and Blueberry Haze, our closest to blue, at the other, and let guests vote with their spoons.
- **Run an ombré.** Line the cups up by their creams: Mango Dream's pale yellow, then Strawberry Fields' blush, then Blueberry Haze's lilac.
- **Give Dubai Chocolate its own spot,** where guests can see the golden kunafa strands mid-cup and pick out the tree-nut flavour at a glance. A small card helps ([table tips](/faq)).

Showing a 96? Use its presentation tray. For a 24 or 48, your own cake stand or tiered tray works well.

sections.heading: How the request works
sections.body:
1. **Build your box** on the [order page](/order?event=baby-shower). Choose the pack, size and flavours.
2. **In the notes,** mention it's for a baby shower and tell us the colours (pink, blue, neutral or a mix).
3. **We confirm within the day;** [what happens next](/faq).

Planning a bridal shower too? It has [its own guide](/events/bridal-showers).

faqs.q: Is there a blue dessert cup for a boy baby shower?
faqs.a: Not a true baby blue. Blueberry Haze comes closest: lilac blueberry cream under a near-black violet compote. It looks right next to navy, lavender or silver, but next to powder blue it reads as purple.

faqs.q: Can I fit more than four colours in a 24?
faqs.a: Not in one 24. It holds up to four flavours, with at least six cups of each. A 48 holds up to eight, or you can add another pack.
